# Serving must have a bounded synthetic process lifecycle without NVML.
exec nvtelemetry help
stdout 'serve'
stdout 'fetch-endpoint'
stdout 'deliver'
env LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$WORK/no-nvml
exec nvtelemetry serve -mock -listen 127.0.0.1:0 -duration 40ms -interval 5ms
stdout 'http://127.0.0.1:[0-9]+/metrics'
! exec nvtelemetry serve
stderr 'explicit device UUID allowlist'
! exec nvtelemetry serve -mock -listen 0.0.0.0:0
stderr 'non-loopback serving requires'
! exec nvtelemetry serve -mock -budget 2 -interval 5ms -listen 127.0.0.1:0
stderr 'budget'

# Invalid configuration must fail before network transmission.
! exec nvtelemetry fetch-endpoint -config duplicate.json
stderr 'invalid endpoint configuration JSON'
! exec nvtelemetry fetch-endpoint -config remote-http.json
stderr 'remote HTTP endpoint requires'
! exec nvtelemetry deliver -signal invented -config duplicate.json -input request.json
stderr 'metrics or logs signal'
! exec nvtelemetry deliver -signal logs -config duplicate.json -input request.json
stderr 'invalid endpoint configuration JSON'

-- duplicate.json --
{"url":"https://example.invalid","URL":"https://other.invalid"}
-- remote-http.json --
{"url":"http://example.invalid","timeout_nanos":1000000000,"max_bytes":4096,
 "workload":{"Provider":"mlflow","Version":"2.22.0","RunID":"run"}}
-- request.json --
{"resourceLogs":[{"scopeLogs":[{"logRecords":[{}]}]}]}
